member.name: M:CheckoutModel.ExpiryPattern
member.remarks:
Pattern:
(\\d{2})\\s*/\\s*(\\d{2})
Explanation:
○ 1st capture group.
○ Match a Unicode digit exactly 2 times.
○ Match a whitespace character atomically any number of times.
○ Match '/'.
○ Match a whitespace character atomically any number of times.
○ 2nd capture group.
○ Match a Unicode digit exactly 2 times.
